column3: Chapter 5, Protective Custody: Mendez truck standoff.
column4: At the final Shoot prompt, wait for Take Deal and accept it. Follow the officer's plan through the high-rise. Reported outcome: Jason and Lucia are betrayed and disappear in the swamp. Base route; other guide variants are disputed.

column3: Chapter 5, reported alternate deal-route tower exit.
column4: Accept Mendez's deal. If an armed Jason is shot while exiting the tower or elevator and Lucia gets Stay Down / Defend Jason, choose Stay Down. Reported: Jason dies and Lucia survives. Unlock for the alternate standoff is uncertain.

column3: Chapter 5, reported alternate deal-route tower exit.
column4: Accept Mendez's deal. If the armed Jason tower standoff triggers, choose Defend Jason instead of Stay Down. Reported: Lucia fires at the task force and both die. Exact prerequisite for this scene remains unconfirmed.

column3: Chapter 5, The End of the Road: bridge police blockade.
column4: Shoot Mendez in Protective Custody to continue the normal finale. At the bridge choose No Surrender (PS5 R2 / Xbox RT). The pair charge the blockade. Reported: both die; this route does not depend on the savings target.

column3: Chapter 5, bridge blockade and post-credits scenes.
column4: Max BuckMe Family Savings to $2,000,000 and strengthen the relationship before the finale. Shoot Mendez; choose No Surrender at the bridge. Some reports describe a later family housing epilogue. This is an epilogue variant, not a different survival result; exact trigger unconfirmed.

column3: Chapter 5, The End of the Road: bridge police blockade.
column4: Build a high/violent Criminal Profile (reported Psycho or Irredeemable), shoot Mendez, and choose Swim for It (PS5 Triangle / Xbox Y). If Jason exits the vehicle holding a pistol, deputies shoot both. Profile threshold is reported, not proven.

column3: Chapter 5, armed bridge exit and post-credits scene.
column4: Maintain the reported armed-Swim conditions and deposit $2,000,000 in Family Savings; ideally keep a strong relationship. Shoot Mendez and choose Swim for It. Some players report a later household epilogue despite both dying. This is an uncertain scene variation.

column3: Chapter 5, The End of the Road: bridge police blockade.
column4: Build a strong Jason/Lucia relationship (Hot Together is recommended), keep Criminal Profiles clean, and leave Family Savings below $2,000,000. Shoot Mendez; choose Swim for It. If Jason exits unarmed, Lucia escapes and Jason goes to prison.

Before the finale: Hot Together relationship, clean profiles, and $2,000,000 deposited in BuckMe Family Savings. Shoot Mendez promptly; choose Swim for It at the bridge. Reported: Lucia escapes, Jason is jailed then freed, and the family reunites.

column3: Chapter 5, deal route; unconfirmed post-credits variant.
column4: PREDICTED ONLY: max Family Savings to $2,000,000 and keep a strong relationship; accept Take Deal at the Mendez standoff and reach the swamp ending. A distinct later household epilogue has not been demonstrated for this route. Do not count as verified.

column3: Chapter 5, alternate tower route; unconfirmed variant.
column4: PREDICTED ONLY: deposit $2,000,000 in Family Savings; accept the Mendez deal, trigger the reported armed tower scene, and choose Stay Down. The extra epilogue and even the armed tower trigger lack reliable verification.

column3: Chapter 5, alternate tower route; unconfirmed variant.
column4: PREDICTED ONLY: deposit $2,000,000 in Family Savings; accept the Mendez deal, trigger the armed tower scene, and choose Defend Jason. A new later epilogue has not been verified. Record this only if observed in-game.
